upload_retention: The application processes photographs and capture metadata to answer the request and does not deliberately write them to persistent application storage. Django can buffer uploads to temporary files, which are closed/removed when the request ends. Hosting, reverse-proxy and diagnostic retention must be verified separately before publication.
deletion_process: Contact hemantsharma.devs@gmail.com for privacy and deletion requests. Describe the request and approximate capture time; do not send another photograph or identity documents unless reasonably necessary. The publisher will assess which records actually exist and applicable rights. Clear Android app storage or uninstall to remove local preferences, saved location and cached images.
audience_statement: General audience; not specifically directed to children. Final Play Console age-group selection must be reviewed.
monetization_statement: The first release has no ads, paid features, in-app purchases, subscriptions or user accounts.
analytics_statement: The first release includes no advertising or analytics SDKs. Server/hosting operational logs and diagnostics are described under retention.
distribution_intent: All Google Play-supported countries/regions permitted for an India-based individual publisher, excluding locations restricted by applicable sanctions or trade rules. Exact Console selection requires verification.
